I like it, but to each their own. You can change the colour to something else if you want. Just put this after the rest of the code:

#header-img-a::before {
 color: #000 !important;
}

To get the original Voat logo back, add this to the end of the stylesheet:

#header-img-a {
 width:auto;
}

#header-img-a:before {
 content: "";
 font: none;
}

#header-img-a img {
 display: block;
}

It still looks pretty good against either the light or dark theme.
